name: isWebMCP
tagline: Turn public web interfaces into evidence-backed WebMCP action plans.
description: isWebMCP audits a public page snapshot, identifies candidate actions, and explains what can and cannot be claimed from source evidence. It also reviews supplied tool contracts and renders the result as an interactive ChatGPT component. Runtime conformance and before/after lift are withheld until the required evidence is supplied.
review_notes: audit_public_url writes a privacy-safe audit-attempt record and an ephemeral report, so readOnlyHint is false. It fetches the user-selected public URL, so openWorldHint is true; it does not authenticate, submit actions, or modify the target site.
Reports are evidence-scoped; source collection failures and truncation remain visible.
No tool represents source-only results as runtime conformance or measured lift.
